topic_brief.title: No-till vs conventional tillage effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does no-till management affect crop yield compared to conventional tillage, and how does this vary by crop type and climate?
topic_brief.intervention_description: No-till or zero-till management (seeds planted directly into undisturbed soil)
topic_brief.comparator_description: Conventional tillage (moldboard plow, disk, chisel, or other inversion/intensive tillage)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop grain yield per unit area
important_moderators: Crop species (wheat, maize, rice, soybean, barley, sorghum, cotton, etc.)
Soil type or texture (clay, loam, sand)
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall -5.7%; Wheat -2.6%; Maize -7.6%; Rice -7.5%; Soybean +0.3%; Oilseed rape -9.0%

rows.title: Energy Requirements and Performance of Different Soil Tillage Systems on the Yield of Maize Crop
rows.treatment_description: Zero tillage (direct drill, no soil disturbance)
rows.notes: Three tillage systems compared: deep tillage (sub soiler + moldboard plow), conventional tillage (disc harrow + cultivator), zero tillage (drill). Yield values stated explicitly in text: DT=5727, CT=5108, ZT=4281 kg/ha. Three replications in RCBD. LSD at 0.05 used for mean separation but no numeric LSD value reported. No SE or SD values given anywhere in the paper. This observation is ZT vs CT (standard no-till vs conventional comparison).

rows.title: Energy Requirements and Performance of Different Soil Tillage Systems on the Yield of Maize Crop
rows.treatment_description: Zero tillage (direct drill, no soil disturbance)
rows.control_description: Deep tillage (sub soiler + moldboard plow, most intensive tillage)
rows.notes: This observation is ZT vs DT (no-till vs most intensive tillage in the study). Deep tillage uses sub soiler + moldboard plow which is the most intensive tillage in this 3-treatment study. Yield values stated explicitly in text. No numeric variance values reported despite LSD being mentioned as the statistical method.

rows.control_description: Conventional moldboard tillage (CT), straw returned, averaged across 5 N rates and 6 seasons (2006-2012)
rows.notes: Means averaged across 5 N rates and 6 seasons. NT significantly lower than CT (different letter groups: NT=b, CT=a). No numeric SE/SD/LSD values reported; only letter groupings from LSD test. n=4 replications in split-plot design. This is the sum of wheat + maize yields per year.
